training_details: Single Qwen3-0.6B + LoRA on RAID train (1.15M rows, 11 attacks x official variants + none, weak-family weighting, title-grouped split) + layout-decoupled augmentation (50% random paragraph-reformat), length-decoupled augmentation (40% mid-truncation variants on long AI samples, breaking the length-as-AI prior), shred-fragment defense (3% label-balanced), 32k fresh pre-LLM Wikipedia human corpus with original formatting (train-side only).

additional_metadata.notes: Fixed version promised in #234. Root cause of the earlier v0.16 FP tail was a formatting/length asymmetry between RAID train and test human texts; v0.21 decouples layout and length from labels. Local eval: heldout AUROC 0.9984, shred-layout human FPR 7.8%, layout effects on fresh-human scores neutralized (raw-with-newlines == flattened).
